desc: Precompute `sub_lcm` for all non-empty subsets of `target` using `math.gcd`.
Initialize DP array of size `2^m` with `inf`, `dp[0]=0`.
For each `n` in `nums`, compute `cost[sub] = (-n) % sub_lcm[sub]` for all non-empty `sub`.
Update DP: `new_dp = dp[:]`, then for each `mask` and each `sub`, update `new_dp[mask | sub] = min(new_dp[mask | sub], dp[mask] + cost[sub])`.
Add quick test cases in a `if __name__ == "__main__":` block to verify against the three examples.
